scenes.text: You just opened your last can of food.
And the radio says stay underground. For months.
You picked the farm. So let's grow food, without the sun.
You break through the floor, and dig down.
Way bigger this time. A whole room, just for food.
Real stairs this time.
Soil from deep down. The top layer could be contaminated.
No sun, so grow lights. Plants mostly use red and blue.
And a bike generator. You pedal, the lights stay on.
Radishes up top. Potatoes on the floor.
But there's a problem nobody thinks about.
In a sealed room, plants run out of carbon dioxide.
Then you breathe out. And every breath feeds them.
And they give you oxygen back.
One month later.
Radishes. Potatoes come in three months.
Your shelves are full again. Enough food for two people.
Then, someone bangs on the hatch.
A family. With a little kid. Begging to come in.
But you only grow enough for two. Do you open the hatch? Top comment decides part three.
